priorityList: Use Reaver's Glaive to apply Reaver's Mark, ideally when Glaive Flurry and Rending Strike buffs are absent.
Cast Metamorphosis if Eye Beam is on cooldown or to extend an existing Metamorphosis, provided no Demonsurge windows are active.
Use The Hunt on cooldown, preferably during Metamorphosis or when damage buffs like Initiative are active.
Cast Vengeful Retreat to trigger Initiative and Inertia buffs just before Eye Beam or Blade Dance windows.
Cast Eye Beam on cooldown to trigger Metamorphosis and Fel-Scarred's Demonsurge buffs.
Use Death Sweep as your highest priority spender during Metamorphosis, especially when a Demonsurge charge is available.
Cast Essence Break immediately after Eye Beam while in Metamorphosis, before using other spenders.
Use Annihilation during Metamorphosis if Demonsurge is available or during the Essence Break window.
Cast Blade Dance on cooldown in AoE, ensuring you have enough Fury (60+) if pooling for Glaive Tempest.
Use Fel Rush to trigger the Inertia buff if it is ready and you are about to use Eye Beam or The Hunt.
Maintain Immolation Aura for Fury generation and to trigger Ragefire damage; use charges freely if talented into A Fire Inside.
Cast Chaos Strike or Annihilation to spend excess Fury (above 75) and prevent capping.
Use Felblade as a priority generator if Fury is low (below 40) or to close the gap to your target.
Use Throw Glaive as a filler to apply Soulscar dots if no other priority abilities are available.
Collect Soul Fragments if Fury is below 40 to maintain resources.
